title: Phobos care data pack

priority.description: Override files only: files apply lowest first (default 0), so a higher number has a later word. Leave it out unless you need it.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.
Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

idleKW.description: Demand with nobody under care, kW; no more than workingKW.

stations.description: Electrical demand by station: bed, monitor.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

bloodLost.description: Blood lost at which a person counts as injured (the game: 40 is fatal); below 40.

infection.description: Infection at which a person counts as injured (the game: 95 is fatal); below 95.

pain.description: Pain at which a person counts as injured (the game: 75 knocks out); below 75.

wound.description: Worst wound cut or blunt damage, 0 to 1, at which a person counts as injured; below 1.

dischargeShare.description: A resting patient gets up below every threshold times this share; below 1.

admission.description: Who counts as injured, and when a resting patient has recovered.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

alerts.description: When a Vigil-2 posts a caution (Medical 0.3.0); a bleeding wound always alerts.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

weightlessHealing.description: Share of normal wound healing a weightless patient keeps under care: 0.05 is the game's own, 1 removes the penalty.

levels.description: What a station adds to the game's own care (Medical 0.2.0).

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

effect.description: slot-item: the item goes onto the wound the game's own way.

item.description: The game item definition used up, one per treatment.

medicSeconds.description: How long a medic takes, in seconds; crew with the skill are quicker.

skill.description: A skill condition, such as SkillMedicalTrauma; crew with it are asked first. Leave out for anyone.

order.description: Lower comes first; ties go by name.

treatments.description: What a medic does for a patient in a Ward-3, by name (Medical 0.4.0).

description: Phobos Medical care pack: station power and admission thresholds. The healing is the game's own Recuperating.
